reason: For a k-rational point x of A^n_k every dual-number point over x sends X_i to a_i + eps v_i with unique v=(v_1,...,v_n) in k^n, and these are exactly the tangent vectors, including n=0 and v=0; 4 facts, 5 steps; Stacks Morphisms Section 29.33 with Vakil 22.2.18 pp.582-583. Uses the cotangent-space theorem only at the k-rational point where it is proved.
